_comment: Project config for `npm run smoke` and the cross-validation in test/integration.test.ts. It pins every setting the predicted routing depends on, so the run is deterministic whatever the machine's global agent config says: the two faux models as the tiers, a Jev transport whose credential is never present (so routing falls to src/router.ts#heuristicTier, offline), a confidence bar the heuristic can clear, and — since billing became a routing input — pay-per-token allowed for both faux models with the entitlement probe off, so eligibility is decided offline and identically on both sides. Tier membership and the switching block mirror test/smoke/agent/modelrouter.json, which the smoke scripts pin via PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR; the values are kept identical so this file isolates the run without silently overriding it.
